about: Human-reviewed corrections to the automated grounding results on the held-out questions. Each correction is a person's decision, made under a rule locked before the results were seen, and points to the review that records it. grounding_card.py reads this file next to the automated result files and shows both numbers. Only the cases listed here were corrected; every other case keeps its automated number.

H5.why: one work-instruction fact written in different words (F4 'which valves are underfilling')
the same work-instruction piece counted as useful
the extra useful piece sat last, at rank 4

handover_recall.why: 17 facts the checker missed because of rewording, Markdown bold marks and special hyphens

faithfulness.about: Range after a person checked the judge's 'not supported' verdicts: low = borderline counted unsupported, high = borderline counted supported.

H2.note: reviewed on the rubric v1 run (60 statements); the v2 judge score falls inside this range
